lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm Kim Minsu, manager in HR.
lines.en: Hello. I'm the applicant, Lee Seoyeon.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me about your work so far?
lines.learner: 영업부를 시작으로 기획부를 거쳐 팀장을 맡았습니다.
lines.en: I started in sales, went through planning, and became team leader.
lines.roman: Yeongeopbureul sijageuro gihoekbureul geochyeo timjangeul matatseumnida.

lines.en: My results last year were the best on the team.

lines.beaver_en: When you were team leader, how many team members did you have?
As a team leader, you must have done less hands-on work.
lines.en: No, I did a lot of hands-on work myself.

lines.beaver: 재택근무 기간에도 팀 관리가 잘 되었습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Did team management go well during remote work too?
lines.beaver_roman: Jaetaekgeunmu giganedo tim gwalliga jal doeeotseumnikka?
lines.learner: 재택근무를 할 때도 팀을 잘 이끌었습니다.
lines.en: I led the team well even while working from home.
lines.roman: Jaetaekgeunmureul hal ttaedo timeul jal ikkeureotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Why did you leave your previous company?
lines.learner: 새로 오신 상사와 업무 방향이 달랐습니다.
lines.en: My new boss and I had different views on the work.
lines.roman: Saero osin sangsawa eommu banghyangi dallatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Was your resignation process wrapped up well?
lines.learner: 네, 퇴직금도 다 받고 잘 정리했습니다.
lines.en: Yes, I received all my severance pay and settled everything.
lines.roman: Ne, toejikgeumdo da batgo jal jeongnihaetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have plans for the future?
lines.en: I'd like to work here until retirement.

lines.beaver: 좋습니다. 결과는 다음 주에 알려 드리겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Good. We'll let you know the result next week.
lines.beaver_roman: Jotseumnida. Gyeolgwaneun daeum jue allyeo deurigetseumnida.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 이 자리에 꼭 맞는 사람이 되겠습니다.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll be the right person for this role.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida. I jarie kkok manneun sarami doegetseumnida.
